style_scale: 1 is plain and natural; 10 is strongly formulaic or AI-like
slop_check: PASS: specific claims, concrete evidence, no canned transitions, no em dash
scientific_gate: PASS: no new scientific performance claim; scope and limits are explicit
factual_gate: PASS: statements checked against the frozen archive and retained receipts
reference_gate: PASS: evidence paths and sources identify the records reviewed
exact_draft_completion: PASS: assessment applies to the saved README.md draft
